about.title: About
about.content: I build AI systems that reason, remember, and act — with a bias toward simplicity and local-first design. At AWS, I work on the Agentic AI org. Outside of work, I build custom agents, MCP servers, developer tools, and the occasional game — all guided by the principle that if you can't audit it, you shouldn't ship it.
